admission.justification: Realized across models/validation.py and models/concepts.py and proved by unit tests; prevents filesystem I/O leaking into pure models, silent frontmatter schema drift, path-traversal visual_ref values, and off-by-N diagnostic line numbers.

applicability: Construction and formatting of ValidationFinding diagnostics and pure-text parsing of Concept Card YAML frontmatter across src/rh_pipeline/models/validation.py and src/rh_pipeline/models/concepts.py.
conditions: ValidationFinding enforces non-empty rule, path and message strings and non-negative non-bool line integers, formatting as rule:path:line:message and sorting by (path, line, rule, message).

parse_concept_card performs zero filesystem I/O, normalizes CRLF/CR line endings, requires exact required/optional keys, rejects YAML body_markdown and unknown keys, validates docs-relative visual_ref paths, and returns exact body_line_offset.
exclusions: Filesystem existence checks for visual_ref, Lean skeleton anchors, cross-card child_concepts resolution and card sourcing rules (sources or lean_anchors) belong to src/rh_pipeline/validate/concepts.py.
statement: ValidationFinding formats diagnostics canonically as rule:path:line:message sorted by (path, line, rule, message), and parse_concept_card parses Concept Card YAML frontmatter purely without filesystem I/O while enforcing exact required/optional keys, rejecting unknown keys and frontmatter body_markdown, validating docs-relative visual_ref paths, and returning exact body_line_offset.
title: Canonical ValidationFinding and pure zero-I/O ConceptCard YAML parser
